outputs.explanation: Panel A top is a bar chart showing mean±s.d. of three independent experiments for cell death (%), but only bars with error bars are shown; no individual data points (dots) from the three replicates are overlaid.
Panel B top is a bar chart of cell death (%) with visible error bars indicating averaged/replicate data, but no individual data points are plotted over the bars.
Panel C is a bar chart showing mean±s.d. of three experiments across time points, but individual data points from the replicate experiments are not shown.
Panel D top is a bar chart of cell death (%) with error bars implying replicate averaging, but the underlying individual data points are not displayed.
